# N64 -> GameCube function correlation

Generated by `python3 -m tools.gcref.correlate` (see README.md here). Candidates, not facts: the GC
build is a divergent later sibling. **conf** = confident pair (score >= 3, 1.5x the runner-up, mutual best). Evidence weights in parentheses: `str` shared string (`(tbl)` = through a pointer table), `call`/`caller` call-graph anchor through an already-paired function, `imm`/`flt` rare shared constant, `jt` switch table size, `fld x<n> <offsets>` struct-offset fingerprint (n rare field offsets shared; re-ranks only, never makes a pair confident), `file` neighbours paired into that GC file, `size` size similarity.

Held-out evaluation:

- n64_label_check: N64 labels from arcade names are speculative, not seeds (top-1 shown, fld re-ranking included): AdjustSteer -> no candidate; no_catchup -> no candidate; pak_delete_file_retry -> _ReadPlayer (pak_delete_file_retry at 0x800A2680, labelled AdjustSpeed until w29n, calls osPfsDeleteFile/osPfsFreeBlocks: a controller-pak routine)
- string_holdout_truth: 22 string-anchored pairs (string score >= 3 and 2x runner-up), two-fold: each half held out with its string channel masked
- string_holdout_top1: 12/22 top-1 from the other channels (21 had any candidate; top-3 15)
- string_holdout_confident_precision: 4/4 confident pairs correct (recall 4/22)
- unmasked_agreement: 21/22 held-out truth pairs confident with all channels

Seeds (14): cosf, huft_build, inflate_block, inflate_dynamic, inflate_fixed, inflate_stored, memchr, memcpy, memset, modf, sinf, sprintf, strchr, strlen
